When I called I was told there wasn't anything under my name or claim number. I thought that would be the end of it. This past Friday I received a text and phone number about the same claim number. I was told I did damage the car and now they say I damaged the carpet as well. I google this phone number 866-3004407. It states this is a scam claiming damage was done to a vehicle rented from enterprise.

I was emailed by connie this week that all reservation are being canceled and that her company is no more.   Where's my money?  I contacted the cruise line and yes,  she canceled it,  but she had only placed a non refundable deposit of $500.  I was told it was paid in full.... where's the rest?
